ownerRequirement: Study Room offers All users, Paid users, Admin, and Admin approval; All users is default. A platform administrator inside the exact room manually admits a waiting user. Preserve existing Inner Chamber restrictions.

findings.claim: Ordinary existing/new rooms default to all signed-in users; four exclusive entry options are rendered.
Current administrator and paid status are enforced before token issuance; paid/admission/catalog state is checked again after asynchronous work.
Administrative decisions require an authoritative platform role and ACTIVE provider identity in this exact physical room/access revision; browser-supplied identity/presence is not trusted.
Pending admission returns before join-token issuance or room creation. Approval alone does not connect; a fresh explicit Enter action is required.
Inner Chamber remains admin-only at UI, Worker catalog validation and SQL; this is the preserved pre-existing exception.
